_comment: Events page. The live Squarespace site listed three past events (Feb 2023, Oct 2022, May 2022) — the dates carried over, but titles, times, locations and descriptions were NOT supplied, so they are marked REPLACE ME rather than invented. Add upcoming events to the `upcoming` array and the page grows an 'Upcoming' section automatically; leave it empty and the page shows only past events.
